slice: FULL SAIL Stage 1 NIGHTWATCH Ch4 Slice B1

findings.red: On bb3d2c40, policy evidence/decisions live only in AUTHENTIC_POLICY_EVIDENCE / AUTHENTIC_POLICY_DECISIONS WeakSets. issuance_id is minted with randomUUID() and cannot be rebound. After process restart or require.cache clear, JSON clones of queue+audit+inbound rows are unissued. Author recompute and 087 handoff require the original objects.
findings.green: 089 persists one append-only issuance-material row per exact queue operation/issuance. Ch1 recoverIssueAndDecideEmailLunaDraftPolicy re-brands evidence/decision with the ORIGINAL issuance_id on a new composition-turn. Live issueAndDecideEmailLunaDraftPolicy still mints; recover is not a generic caller factory.

findings.red: Canonical draft authenticity is AUTHENTIC_AUTHOR_DRAFTS plus a WeakMap plan (template_id, tone, question_key, acknowledgment_key). Queue stores only draft_digest. Re-running the model after restart can change the plan, so the digest will not match. inbound 063/082 has subject/body_text/sender but not classifier, grounded values, or plan.
findings.green: Material stores the four plan enums plus classifier scalars and grounded found-fields (no rendered subject/body, no policy_text, no quoted_history). Ch2 recoverEmailLunaDraftAuthorFromAuthenticPlan renders deterministically with no model call and brands AUTHENTIC_AUTHOR_DRAFTS. Digest must equal the queued digest or fail closed.

findings.red: 085/086 audit stores fact_refs[] only: no guest content, fact values, or JSON. Queue is claim/lease identity. Journal is handoff_established body_digest. None of these can reconstruct grounded booking/payment/catalog facts after restart.
findings.green: tenant_email_luna_automation_issuance_material is a new one-owner table. Confidential booking codes and payment amounts live only there. They never appear in logs, exceptions, queue, audit, or journal. Guest body stays on inbound 082; persist/load join the inbound reference.

findings.red: 086/088 enqueue can commit a pending/claimable queue row with no reconstitution material. A restarted worker that claimed that row would have to invent facts, accept caller-trusted objects, or skip author+validator.
findings.green: 089 BEFORE INSERT trigger refuses a queue row unless matching material already exists in the same transaction. persist_and_enqueue inserts material then enqueue atomically. Pre-089 nonempty queue without material fails 089 up. Empty migrate is required.

findings.red: A worker GRANT SELECT on the material table would leak booking codes and payment amounts across mapped-location RLS mistakes, and would let a caller read reconstitution JSON without the scoped load predicate.
findings.green: Workers receive no raw material SELECT/DML. Load is SECURITY DEFINER, authorizes session_user in the locking/selection predicate before touching the row, requires exact client/location and operation/issuance, joins inbound 082, and returns no row for foreign location, cancelled/handoff_required/handed_off, or missing inbound. PUBLIC revoked. 089 does not GRANT or CREATE ROLE.
